AMA about /v/CoOpGaming: Your Friendly Co-Op Gaming Subverse

This is one I started myself, and my favorite sub to add content to. Most of my news posts in /v/gaming are a result of combing the news for co-op gaming related content. Most of the time it's just me posting, so I try to treat it like a blog or a collection of resources for anyone who needs it; that way seeing other people post here and there is more like an added surprise. If you're a fan of cooperative gaming or just enjoy the community spirit of playing games cooperatively, check it out! /v/CoOpGaming.
What would be a fun game for an avid gamer (me) to play with my girlfriend, who isn't a gamer but loves stuff like Mario Kart and Super Mario?

Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime would be my first pick. It's a cute little co-op game that makes you and a buddy pilot the same spaceship, jumping from station to station to control the ship and rescue bunnies.

Never Alone is a co-op story/puzzle game that stars an Eskimo and her fox friend as they tell traditional Alaskan legends.

Castle Crashers, Battleblock Theater, and Monaco: What's Yours is Mine are slightly more fast paced, but just as accessible for new gamers. Diablo 3 is great one in this category as well.

Getting into more advanced (and first person camera) territory, Portal 2 is a great co-op puzzle game and a good way to learn first person controls in games.

Gaming with an SO is a great way to spend time together, so I'm glad you're interested in finding more games you can share!

Edit: and if you play on PC, check out this thread from /v/gaming.
